title: Chapter 773
paragraphs: Chapter 773
Episode 190. Mariett Hister's Inheritance Site (3)
Squeak!
With smiles stretching from ear to ear, Teben and Zen stared at the two with considerable anticipation.
Their faces were so full of expectation that it felt like you could feel their heartbeat, even though they had the form of ghosts.
"We... did do it."
[Woah! See, what did I tell you! You wouldn't have been able to enter if you didn't do that!]
[Huh, so the golem and that cursed creature weren't lying, damn. Take this!]
It seemed like the two had made a bet on whether their descendants who found the inheritance site would follow the entrance conditions.
Jin was on Zen's side. Zen pulled out a bundle of papers from his pocket and handed them to Teben. The golem sighed at this sight.
[I've said it thousands of times, those are not your belongings, but my property... why are you betting with someone else's stuff.]
Regardless, Teben snatched the paper from Zen and expressed his victory after about 350 years with his whole body.
[Kyakyakya!]
Zen and Teben, the two geniuses who were suspected of creating the long-range communication device, were in an unbalanced state.
This was probably due to the fact that they 'recorded themselves on the inheritance site' and the passage of 350 years.
Moreover, during that long period of time, only they and the golem would have been around.
Considering the calm style of the letter, the sight of the two laughing with excitement was touching.
"It seems Teben Hister has won, congratulations."
Instead of showing a bitter expression, Jin said so.
He thought it would be better to go along with the atmosphere.
[Haha, thank you! Jin Runcandel, was it? You're very flexible for a Runcandel!]
"Thank you. But what's that paper used for? It doesn't look like money."

[Ah, this is a magic storage paper. The golem keeps insisting it's his property, but where is there yours and mine here, really. More importantly! I want to be congratulated by our descendants, not outsiders.]
"Congratulations, Ancestor Teben."
[Yes, yes. We've been waiting for you for a long time.]
[Heh, you forgot that we were waiting for a descendant just a while ago.]
[Well, there was probably some historical manipulation about our Hister family, so it's an unavoidable problem, Zen. Plus, we're spectres, so our memory is weak to begin with.]
[Oh, right! Kids, what happened to our family? The Rutbergs! They didn't go extinct, did they?]
"We're safe."
Valeria spent some time explaining to them how they met Saiyal and found the inheritance site.
[...Ah, I remember more clearly now. That's such a relief! Zen, just as we predicted, they couldn't find your family. And our family line also wasn't wiped out. Kyakyakya!]
[But, why do you look so well even after coming all this way? We were like beggars wandering for days.]
[That's because, the successful ones this time, used a shortcut. Possessing power that can ignore the set difficulty.]
The traps set in Mariett's inheritance site were originally set based on Honka.
It was designed so that if one could barely beat Honka, they could reach the final point of the inheritance site after much hardship.

[Moreover, because I am not an enemy, the first-level hostility did not apply. I only exerted 50% of my original combat power. Even if I had used all my abilities, it wouldn't have made a difference.]
[Hmm, that feels unfair somehow. If it was that simple, it feels like you're getting our creation too easily. Don't you think so, Teben?]
[That's true! We really struggled!]
"Is the creation you're talking about the communication device?"
[Yes, that's right, it's the communication device!]
[It's a long-distance communication device! There's still nothing like it out there, right?]
"Yes, there isn't. The limit is something like Zipple Matopju's staff that gives signals."
[That won't do, we can't just give you something like that. Let's have another test.]
[Oh, good. What kind of test?]
[Let's decide that while these guys are looking at the inheritance site. Be nervous! If you don't pass that test, we really won't give you the communication device.]
Zen and Teben hurriedly ran off somewhere and disappeared.

[They may act like that now, but they were once great magicians and engineers. Don't worry too much about the test. It certainly won't be hard. Even if they've become fools, they've never forgotten their duties and missions.]
The duties and missions of record magicians and pioneering engineers.
That was to pass on their inventions to those who were qualified.
They had something in common with the ancestors of Runcandel who were resurrected with the power of chaos in the shrine of malevolence but didn't end up corrupting.
Ziiing....
When the golem stretched out his hand over the record windows of Mariett floating in the air, a pleasant vibration filled the entire inheritance site.
[My master foresaw a moment like today a long time ago.]
"Foresaw? What does that mean?"
[However, fortunately, Valeria Hister. You do not look very tired or lonely.]
Did Mariett foresee Valeria's future?
Jin looked at the golem with such questions.
The golem's touch was activating the record window.
[I will take you both into my master's records. Please lie down.]
As the two lay down, the surroundings began to darken gradually.
Soon, when it became completely dark, the record windows flowing like a blue Milky Way on the ceiling beautifully lit up.
[You will feel drowsy. Do not resist.]
Following his words, after a while, the two were able to immerse themselves in past stories, just like when they had drunk the root beer in the Wanta Forest.
Jin and Valeria became observers in the video with a semi-transparent appearance.
April 1, 1391, Honka Island.
'It seems like the record of the day when the ancestor Mariett met Honka.'
'It seems like the fight has just ended.'
Jin and Valeria watched Honka, who was panting with half his body frozen.
Honka didn't have a name yet.
Mariett was a woman with a very mysterious look.
A large frame that was not much smaller compared to Honka, red hair covering more than half of her body, and eyes that sparkled playfully.
Jin and Valeria were momentarily awed by her appearance, their mouths agape. It was the first time both of them had seen someone so big.
Even Hedo would not look so big standing next to Mariett.
"Why do you live alone on this island and kill people who come near? You've already scolded me several times."
[Hmph, there's no such reason. Kill me if you're going to kill me!]

"If you had killed even one human, I would have done so. But since you only chased people away pretending to be a current under the sea, I kindly spared you. If you keep doing this, you will soon be caught by the Empire or Zipple and get eradicated. So repent through me and regain enlightenment."
[What if I don't want to?]

"Then I can't help it. It's an issue of privacy invasion and I try to refrain from it as much as possible, but I have no choice but to look into your records in detail. I need to know why you're doing this. If I wait any longer to hear it directly from you, I think you're going to die."
[What is this, huh. What's this! Why are my memories suddenly being drawn in the air!]
"Hmm, yes. As I expected, you gained an obsession trying to overcome being tormented by humans and other creatures."
[Uh, stop it!]

"But usually, when you get such an obsession, you tend to slaughter weaker beings out of hatred, but instead, you chose perfect isolation. What does that mean? It means you're worthy of receiving the award. Come here, let me give you a hug. Oh, can't move because you're frozen? Then I'll come to you, well."
Honka was startled and protested, but as soon as Mariette covered him with her massive body, he was intoxicated by an irresistible sense of security.
That's how Mariette and the mischievous bullfrog monster became friends. Mariette named him Honka, after the name of the island.
A brief recollection of Mariette and Honka's fairy-tale-like memories played.
The two sitting in front of the bonfire eating together, or Mariette telling Honka stories of the outside world.
Honka never opened his heart to anyone other than Mariette, but he never threatened anyone passing near the island.
"Now, many Histers come to the hereditary land I'm creating, but eventually our family will be defeated by the Zipple and decline. The Histers visiting here will gradually decrease."
"Even though you're so strong, you can't defeat the Zipple? Hister's magic is the best."

"They have much more power than us and they're cunning, so there's no choice. Anyway, surely within a few hundred years... no, in less than a hundred years, our family will be on the brink of extinction. I wonder how many will survive, ten? Five? Perhaps only one person will remain."
"Why talk about that now, like someone who's about to leave."
"I don't have much time left. I have to complete a legacy that will be a strength to the successors who will come to the family when it weakens."
"What do you mean, did you get sick?"

"It's not a disease, it's a curse. I got it in a battle with Zipple's Wraith squad. It's a curse called Kian's blood, once you get it, you're gradually eaten by pain and die. My progress is about 50% now. If I resist well, I have about three years left."
At the sudden approach of parting, Honka didn't know how to react.
Mariette looked at Honka and smiled.
"When I die, you should also leave this place and make new friends. It will be enough to leave the protection of the hereditary land to the Golem I'm making now."
"I don't want to."
"Then when your time comes, you'll regret it. Dying while missing only me is too lonely. Do I have to worry about you even after I die?"
"Stop talking about dying, and look for a way to lift the curse. If you do that, I'll leave the island and help you."

"Looking for a way to lift a curse, whose location is unknown, and completing a work for the successor. Naturally, my remaining time should be spent on the latter. For the family, for me, and for the world."
"Even without you, many Histers are already creating hereditary lands. Is that not enough?"
"Most of them are overly pedantic and will only leave a sense of mission to the already tired successors. My hereditary land is intended to be a more special resting place than that."
Having said that, Mariette suddenly turned her head towards Jin and Valeria.
It was an act to give the impression of speaking directly to the successor who was observing this record.
"So you guys, enjoy my remaining time. I hope it can be a little consolation for the lonely and difficult life you must have been through."
